profile.headline: Software Engineer II - Enterprise Identity specializing in Golang and identity protocols
profile.summary:
I'm a Rice University graduate with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, currently contributing as a Software Engineer II at HashiCorp. Skilled in implementing enterprise identity protocols such as SCIM, SAML, and OIDC using Golang, alongside creating frontend Ember and TypeScript components. Core competencies include identity management, protocol design, analytics integration, and delivering impactful solutions that enhance product capabilities.  

At HashiCorp, I've partnered with teams to storyboard sprint commitments and develop CLI commands leveraging Auth0. I've also led incident retrospectives and tracking analytics initiatives. I am motivated by creating scalable solutions that bring a collaborative approach to secure and seamless identity systems within dynamic organizations.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Enterprise Identity
positions.description:
• Storyboarded sprint commitments and investigated unknown dependencies.
• Led incident retrospectives, implemented tracking analytics, and created CLI commands leveraging Auth0.
• Implemented SCIM, SAML, OIDC protocols in Golang and created frontend Ember components for enterprise identity solutions.
positions.insights: Skills: Identity and Access Management (IAM) · Incident Management · SCIM · OAuth · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the development of custom Github Action workflows to release microservice SDK updates efficiently. 

• Enhanced Bash scripts for SDK generation to improve productivity.
• Leveraged Auth0 to create CLI commands in Golang for seamless user login and session generation.
positions.insights: Skills: Github Actions · Bash Scripting · Swagger API · Microservice Architechture

positions.title: Analytics Intern
positions.description:
Developed a machine learning library for signals analysis using Tensorflow, leading to improved data processing capabilities.

• Refactored API code bases to decrease runtime by half and enhance code readability.
• Contributed to the innovation and growth of RENEW Labs (Rice University) through impactful data analysis projects.
positions.insights: Skills: TensorFlow · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced efficiency model by analyzing server runtime data using Zipkin, Brave, and Spring Web
• Compiled runtime information into color-coded browser tool for easy visualization
• Contributed to Dell Technologies by improving application performance
